```{r}
##packages
library(pacman)
p_load(Seurat,SeuratData,Matrix,dplyr,DropletUtils,presto,gprofiler2,ggplot2,patchwork,gplots,cowplot,gprofiler2,openxlsx, plyr,scDblFinder,BiocParallel)
```

#1LOAD THE DATA
```{r}
##load the data: from the initial code data_3.rmd

bec_obj = readRDS("data/process/temp/bec_subset.rds")
table(bec_obj$celltype)
```

#2-NORM,FVF,SCALE AND RPCA
```{r}
###normalize, scale, runpca,find varfeature####

bec_obj = NormalizeData(bec_obj)
bec_obj = FindVariableFeatures(bec_obj)
bec_obj = ScaleData(bec_obj, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
bec_obj = RunPCA(bec_obj)

```



#3-INTEGRATIIN WITH HARMONY
```{r}
##perform integration: no need to join layers###
library(harmony)
bec_obj =RunHarmony(
  bec_obj, 
  group.by.vars = "orig.ident",
  orig.reduction = "pca", 
  dims.use = 1:30
)
Reductions(bec_obj) # to check harmony: run succesfully


#visualization
bec_obj = RunUMAP(bec_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims= 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
p1=DimPlot(
  bec_obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  group.by = c("sample"),
 label.size = 2, shuffle = T
)
p1 
```



#4-CHECK THE TRESHOLD FOR THE PCA AND THE RESOLUTION BEFORE FINDING THE CLUSTERS AFTER INTEGRATION.BASED ON DATA SIZE , WE CAN CHOSE A RANGE OF RESOLUTION

```{r}
#use ans ELBOWPLOT:shows the variance explained by each principal component (PC).You use it to decide how many PCs to keep
ElbowPlot(bec_obj, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca") +
  ggtitle("Elbow plot - BEC sample")
```

#4-1 PERFORM DIFFERENT RESOLUTION:
```{r}

#1 Build the nearest-neighbor graph (required before clustering)
bec_obj <- FindNeighbors(bec_obj, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony")

#2 Create clusters at resolutions from 0.3 to 1.0
for (res in seq(0.1,1, by = 0.1)) {
  bec_obj <- FindClusters(bec_obj, resolution = res)
}

#3 Get all clustering resolution columns from metadata
res_cols <- grep("RNA_snn_res", colnames(bec_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)


#4 Plot each resolution separately
for (res in res_cols) {
  p <- DimPlot(bec_obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction =  "umap.harmony") +
       ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
  print(p)
}

#5 (Optional) Combine all plots into one grid for comparison
library(patchwork)

plots <- lapply(res_cols, function(res) {
  DimPlot(bec_obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap.harmony") +
    ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
})

wrap_plots(plots)

```

#4-2 CLUSTERS 


```{r}
#### clusters after integration
bec_obj = FindNeighbors(bec_obj, reduction="harmony", dims = 1:30)
bec_obj = FindClusters(bec_obj, resolution =0.5, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters") 
```



#5 PLOTS WITH THE CLUSTERS
```{r}
##plots with the clusters

library(RColorBrewer)

# Number of clusters
n_clusters <- length(levels(Idents(bec_obj)))

# Create enough distinct colors
if(n_clusters <= 12){
  my_colors <- brewer.pal(n_clusters, "Paired")
} else {
  # For more than 12 clusters, interpolate a larger palette
  my_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(n_clusters)
}

# Set identities if not already
Idents(bec_obj) <- "seurat_clusters"  # replace with your cluster column

# Plot
p = DimPlot(
  bec_obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  label = TRUE,
  label.size = 5,
  repel = TRUE,
  cols = my_colors
) + ggtitle("UMAP_BEC -Resolution 0.5")
p
#SAVE 
ggsave(filename = "output/temp/umap_bec_resolution.png", plot= p, width = 10, height = 8)
```

#6- FIND ALL MARKERS IN ALL CLUSTERS 
```{r}
##find all markers###########################
#first
all_markers_bec <- FindAllMarkers(
  bec_obj,
  only.pos = TRUE,     # only genes upregulated in each cluster
  min.pct = 0.25,      # minimum % of cells expressing the gene
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)
# 2️⃣ Keep only significant markers
all_markers_bec <- all_markers_bec %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)


#3 save (important)
library(openxlsx)
write.xlsx(
  all_markers_bec,
  file = "output/temp/all_markers_bec.xlsx"
)
#to load
#all_markers_bec = read.xlsx("output/temp/all_markers_bec.xlsx")

#######this is to extract the top 30 markers ########

#1️⃣ Add gene and cluster info
all_markers_bec$feature <- all_markers_bec$gene
all_markers_bec$group <- all_markers_bec$cluster



# 3️⃣ Get cluster IDs
clusters <- unique(all_markers_bec$group)

# 4️⃣ Extract top 30 genes for each cluster
top_genes_list <- list()

for (clust in clusters) {
  top_genes <- all_markers_bec %>%
    filter(group == clust) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30) %>%
    pull(feature)
  
  top_genes_list[[paste0("cluster_", clust)]] <- top_genes
}

# 5️⃣ Print top 30 marker genes for each cluster
for (clust in names(top_genes_list)) {
  cat("=== ", clust, " ===\n")
  print(top_genes_list[[clust]])
  cat("\n")
}
```

#7-THE PROPORTION OF DONORS IN EACH CLUSTERS
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)


# Make sure dplyr functions are used explicitly
meta = bec_obj@meta.data

#the  percentage 
donors_counts = meta %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(harmony_clusters,Donors) %>% #count cells each donor use in each cluster
  dplyr::summarise( n= dplyr::n(),.groups = "drop") %>% #numb of cells
  dplyr::group_by(harmony_clusters) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = n /sum(n))  #fraction of cells per donor

 
#plot
my_colors <- brewer.pal(12, "Set3") #color
p= ggplot(donors_counts, aes(x = harmony_clusters, y = proportion, fill = Donors)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 1)), #to see the proportion 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  labs(title = "PROPORTION OF Donor in BEC_CLUSTER ",
       x = "Cluster", y = "Proportion of cells") +
  theme_minimal()
p
  #save
ggsave(filename = "output/temp/Prop_donor_bec.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 8)


```




#8-Correlation of cluster gene expression based on marker genes only. -AverageExpression (using only the marker genes for all clusters)


#8-1 the AverageExpression with markers genes(within clusters)
```{r}
#1-EXTRACT THE MARKER GENES#####
library(openxlsx)
colnames(all_markers_bec)

#select col#if we have to save it but not necessary
marker = all_markers_bec[, c("gene", "cluster", "avg_log2FC", "p_val_adj")]
#remove duplicate
marker_genes = unique(marker)

#2-GET UNIQUE MARKER GENES
marker_genes = unique(all_markers_bec$gene)

#3 filter MG
#all genes in rna assay
gene_in_bec = rownames(bec_obj[["RNA"]])

#only genes present in the object
marker_genes_filtered <- marker_genes[marker_genes %in% gene_in_bec]

length(marker_genes_filtered)  # should be > 0

#4 averageEpression per cluster
avr_exp = AverageExpression(
  bec_obj,
  features = marker_genes_filtered,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)

#3 to get the matrix 
avr_exp_matrix = avr_exp$RNA
dim(avr_exp_matrix)
```



#8-1-1 PLOT
```{r}
#plot
library(pheatmap)
p=pheatmap(
  avr_exp_matrix,
  scale = "row",
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  main = "Average Expression of Marker Genes per BEC_Cluster"
)
p
ggsave(
  filename = "output/temp/avr_Bec.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)
```





#8-2 THE CORRELATION 
```{r}
#1-correlation between clusters
#need numeric matrix
avr_exp_matrix = as.matrix(avr_exp$RNA)
#correlation
cluster_cor = cor(avr_exp_matrix,method = "spearman") # or spearman
```


#8-2-2 PLOT
```{r}
#plots
p=pheatmap(
  cluster_cor,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,

)
p
#to save


ggsave(file ="output/temp/cor_bec.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```



#9-ANNOTATION:USE THE CORRELATION AND THE DOTPLOT TO DO THE ANNOTATION
```{r}
#BASED ON THE EXPRESSION OF MARKERS FROM #5 and the CORRELATION LETS ANNOTATE
new_ann = c(
  "0"="vBEC", "1"="cBEC", "2"="vBEC", "3"="aBEC", "4"="cBEC", "5"="aBEC", "6"="cBEC", "7"="cBEC", "8"="cBEC", "9"="cBEC", "10"="aBEC", "11"="aBEC", "12"="aBEC", "13"="aBEC", "14"="vBEC", "15"="aBEC"
)

#Save the cell type labels in metadata
bec_obj$new_ann = (mapvalues(
  x = as.character(bec_obj$harmony_clusters),#map numb as string
  from = names(new_ann),
  to = new_ann
))

 #Convert to factor and drop unused levels
bec_obj$new_ann <- factor(bec_obj$new_ann, levels = unique(new_ann))
table(bec_obj$new_ann)
plt = DimPlot(
  bec_obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  group.by = "new_ann",   # legend will show cell type names
  label = T,            # optional: add labels on UMAP
  repel = TRUE,            # avoid overlapping labels
  pt.size = 0.5
) 
plt

ggsave(
  filename = "output/temp/bec_annotation_umap.png",
  plot = plt,
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)
```
